user_decision: Exclude all circling approaches from CDFA and VDP data and UI lists.

rule.description: Exclude any published procedure whose approach is circling-only (e.g. VOR A, NDB A, VOR B/C, unless a runway-specific straight-in approach is clearly identified).
rule.do_not_exclude: Do not remove the actual airport chart from the regular APP chart browser; remove from CDFA/VDP calculation/display only.

data_quality: This file is an exclusion policy only. No geometry or altitude model is certified by this manifest.
note: Includes 19 previously pending charts and 22 already excluded ones. All exclusion identities sourced from 2621 PDF register.
